announcements.headline: Outcome of Board meeting held on November 02, 2026
announcements.insight: The board met following the October intimation for Q2/H1 results. Shareholders should await the subsequent financial disclosure to assess performance.

announcements.headline: Intimation of Board Meeting for the Q2 and H1 FY27
announcements.insight: UPL LIMITED schedules a board meeting to consider Q2 and H1 FY27 results, following the Q1FY27 earnings call notice in July. Shareholders should await the subsequent financial results announcement.

announcements.headline: Outcome of the 42nd AGM held on August 6, 2026.
announcements.insight: The AGM outcome confirms shareholder approval of the composite scheme of arrangement announced in July. This follows the Q1FY27 earnings call and June 2026 financial results.

announcements.headline: Financial results quarter ended June 30, 2026
announcements.insight: UPL LIMITED reports financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. This follows earlier notices regarding the AGM and a composite scheme of arrangement.

announcements.headline: Update on Composite Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.insight: The composite scheme update follows the June AGM notice and July board meeting. Shareholders should monitor for court sanction outcomes.

announcements.headline: Intimation of BM Earnings Call for Q1FY27
announcements.insight: UPL LIMITED is scheduling a BM Earnings Call for Q1FY27. This follows the FY 2025-26 Annual Report in July 2026, indicating a progression to interim financial updates.

announcements.headline: Notice - 42nd AGM and Annual Report for FY 2025-26
announcements.insight: Notice of the 42nd AGM follows the June dividend intimation. Shareholders should watch for voting outcomes at this scheduled meeting.

announcements.headline: Intimation of AGM and Record Date for Dividend
announcements.insight: UPL Limited has intimated its Annual General Meeting and record date for a dividend. Shareholders should note these dates to determine eligibility.
